content:
Nabu Casa has launched the Home Assistant Connect AUX-2, an ESP32-S3-based smart home controller that combines audio streaming, RS-232 serial control, Bluetooth LE proxy, and USB expansion for Z-Wave connectivity. It is designed for older audio systems, TVs, AV receivers, UPSs, solar inverters, and other devices to integrate into Home Assistant without cloud services. More specifically, the device features a Texas Instruments PCM5122 DAC for analog and optical audio output, two RS-232 ports, a USB-A port, and a Grove connector for additional sensors. It also supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Ethernet with 802.3af Power over Ethernet (PoE), so you can install it away from the main Home Assistant server. Home Assistant Connect AUX-2 specifications: SoC – Espressif ESP32-S3R8 dual-core Tensilica LX7 MCU up to 240 MHz with WiFi and Bluetooth LE wireless connectivity Connectivity Wireless – 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 4 (802.11b/g/n), Bluetooth 5 LE Ethernet – 10/100 Mbps RJ45 port [...]
